description: Get a message to sign with the wallet you will pay from. Signing is free, sends nothing to the chain and moves no funds - it only shows the address is yours. Do this once, before your first order: an account with a proved wallet pays on-chain by itself, and one without is sent a payment link that only a person can open. Needs your API key in the Authorization header: "Bearer hsq_agent_...".

address.description: The 0x address you will pay from.

name: get_wallet_challenge
title: Start proving the wallet you pay from
